assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NextSeq 2000) of in vitro expanded, second-passage FAPs from rat m. soleus
primary_estimand: Effect of hindlimb-suspension unloading duration (Contr / HS7 / HS14) on the transcriptome of cultured FAPs (time-course LRT, then degPatterns clustering). This is a disuse/unloading estimand; the study contains no exercise, training or reloading arm.
sample_inclusion: GEO: 12 libraries = 3 unloading groups x 2 differentiation days x 2 replicates. Paper S2.2.p4: at each time point FAPs from the 8 animals were COMBINED before in vitro expansion, so each group is one pooled isolation; rep1/rep2 are culture replicates of that pool.
planned_contrasts: LRT across Contr/HS7/HS14 (S2.8.p1, S3.6.p1; five clusters of >=30 genes at p.adj<0.01; total DEG count not reported in the text)
HS7 vs Contr and HS14 vs Contr highlighted for PPAR pathway genes (FIG7), no counts reported
paper_method: DESeq2 LRT (full ~ unloading time vs reduced ~1; whether differentiation day was in the model is not stated), DEGreport degPatterns, clusterProfiler GSEA
paper_results: Cluster 1 cell cycle up in HS7; cluster 2 glycolysis (Eno3, Pfkl, Pgk1, Aldoa, Pkm) increasing; cluster 4 cytokines (Cxcl1, Cxcl3, Cxcl6, Grem2, Wnt5a) up at HS7; cluster 5 PPAR/lipid genes (Pparg, Fabp4, Lpl, Plin1, Acox1, Cpt1c, Rxra, Hmgcs1) down in HS7/HS14
